title: Register bound guard
statement: Let $A$ be a register program, $x$ an input, $B$ a natural number, and $a$ a configuration consisting of a control state, register values, and an optional answer. If the precondition of $A$ holds at $a$ for input $x$, and every register value is at most $B$, then $a$ satisfies the guard requiring both conditions.
hypotheses_covered: The precondition of $A$ holds at $a$ for $x$
Every register value in $a$ is at most $B$
